proposed_urls.rationale: 29B.10.010 Scope of definitions - sets the title-wide definitions scope; required to interpret Chapter 29B.50 (mirror of 42.17A.005 head).
29B.10.060 Benefit - benefit definition used in lobbying gift/expenditure reporting.
29B.10.140 Compensation - compensation definition used in lobbyist registration and reporting thresholds.
29B.10.270 Gift - gift definition used in lobbyist gift-disclosure provisions.
29B.10.330 Legislation - legislation definition used in lobbying-activity scope.
29B.10.340 Legislative office - legislative-office definition used in employment-of-legislators provisions.
29B.10.350 Lobby-Lobbying - directly defines the regulated activity; load-bearing for all of 29B.50.
29B.10.360 Lobbyist - directly defines the regulated person; load-bearing for all of 29B.50.
29B.10.370 Lobbyist's employer - directly defines the principal; load-bearing for 29B.50.080.
29B.10.380 Ministerial functions - excludes ministerial activities from 'lobbying' under 29B.50.
29B.10.390 Participate - defines participation under 29B.50.090 (legislative-activities-of-state-agencies disclosure).
29B.10.400 Person - chapter-wide definition of regulated person; used throughout 29B.50.
29B.50.010 Registration of lobbyists - central registration requirement (mirror of 42.17A.600).
29B.50.020 Code of conduct-Verification-Penalty - lobbyist code-of-conduct certification (new in 2024-2025 reorg, mirrors 42.17A.603).
29B.50.030 Photograph and information-Publication - publication of registered-lobbyist information (mirror of 42.17A.605).
29B.50.040 Exemption from registration and reporting - scope carve-outs (mirror of 42.17A.610).
29B.50.050 Reporting by lobbyists-Rules - periodic lobbyist activity/expenditure reports (mirror of 42.17A.615).
29B.50.060 Notification to person named in report - disclosure-notice obligations (mirror of 42.17A.620).
29B.50.070 Special reports-Lobbyists-Late contributions or large totals (mirror of 42.17A.625).
29B.50.080 Reports by employers of registered lobbyists - principal-side disclosure obligations (mirror of 42.17A.630).
29B.50.090 Legislative activities of state agencies and elective officials - public-sector lobbying disclosure (mirror of 42.17A.635).
29B.50.100 Grass roots lobbying campaigns - indirect-lobbying disclosure (mirror of 42.17A.640).
29B.50.110 Employment of legislators, board or commission members, or state employees-Statement, contents (mirror of 42.17A.645).
29B.50.120 Employment of unregistered persons - prohibitions tied to the registration regime (mirror of 42.17A.650).
29B.50.130 Lobbyists' duties, restrictions-Penalties for violations (mirror of 42.17A.655).
29B.60.010 Civil remedies and sanctions-Referral for criminal prosecution - title-wide enforcement reaching lobbyist-disclosure violations (mirror of 42.17A.750).
29B.60.020 Violations-Determination by commission-Penalties-Procedure - PDC enforcement procedure (mirror of 42.17A.755).
29B.60.040 Enforcement-Attorney general - AG enforcement authority (mirror of 42.17A.765).
29B.60.050 Limitation on actions - limitation period for chapter-wide enforcement including lobbyist-disclosure violations (mirror of 42.17A.770).
42.17A.600 Registration of lobbyists - central lobbyist-registration requirement (legacy mirror; canonical 2025 home is 29B.50.010).
42.17A.603 Code of conduct-Verification-Penalty (legacy mirror of 29B.50.020).
42.17A.605 Photograph and information-Publication (legacy mirror of 29B.50.030).
42.17A.610 Exemption from registration and reporting (legacy mirror of 29B.50.040).
42.17A.615 Reporting by lobbyists-Rules (legacy mirror of 29B.50.050).
42.17A.620 Notification to person named in report (legacy mirror of 29B.50.060).
42.17A.625 Special reports-Lobbyists-Late contributions or large totals (legacy mirror of 29B.50.070).
42.17A.630 Reports by employers of registered lobbyists (legacy mirror of 29B.50.080).
42.17A.635 Legislative activities of state agencies and elective officials (legacy mirror of 29B.50.090).
42.17A.640 Grass roots lobbying campaigns (legacy mirror of 29B.50.100).
42.17A.645 Employment of legislators (legacy mirror of 29B.50.110).
42.17A.650 Employment of unregistered persons (legacy mirror of 29B.50.120).
42.17A.655 Lobbyists' duties, restrictions-Penalties for violations (legacy mirror of 29B.50.130).

notes: WA 2025 has undergone the 2024-2025 RCW reorganization that moved the lobbying-disclosure regime out of Title 42 Chapter 42.17A (its 2015 home) into a NEW Title 29B 'Campaign Disclosure and Contribution' Chapter 29B.50 'Lobbying Disclosure and Restrictions.' Justia's 2025 vintage exposes both: Chapter 29B.50 contains 13 lobbying-core sections (29B.50.010-130), which are a 1:1 mirror plus two splits (.020 Code of conduct, .030 Photograph) of the 2015 42.17A.600-655 lobbying-side block; Title 42 Chapter 42.17A in 2025 still hosts the same lobbying sections (42.17A.600-655) alongside its now-canonical campaign-finance sections. This is likely a Justia transitional state during the reorg. Both regimes are proposed (42 URLs total: 25 from 29B + 13 legacy mirrors from 42.17A) so downstream Phase C can deduplicate by semantic mirror tags and/or select an authoritative-source policy. Definitions chapter 29B.10 is per-section atomized (one-term-per-section, Wisconsin-style) so 12 lobbying-relevant definition sections are proposed individually (vs. the single 42.17A.005 catch-all in 2015). Enforcement chapter 29B.60 is also a 1:1 mirror of the 2015 42.17A.750/.755/.765/.770 enforcement support sections. Per-section-leaf URL convention (Wisconsin Example D shape). tree_depth=3 (title -> chapter -> section), matching WA 2015. No Playwright/Cloudflare errors. NOT a parallel-regime case in the FL/NY sense (no separate executive-branch lobbying chapter) - it is a single-regime mid-transition: 29B.50 is the post-reorg canonical, 42.17A is the pre-reorg legacy still hosted on Justia.
